questions.question: When Paul laid his hands on about twelve disciples in Ephesus who knew only John's baptism, what happened?

answers.text: The Holy Spirit came on them and they spoke in tongues and prophesied
A bright light flashed around them and they all fell to the ground
The whole building shook and every door in the place flew open

questions.question: In Ephesus, God did extraordinary miracles through Paul. What was taken to the sick so they would be healed?

answers.text: Handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched Paul
Water from the pool of Siloam
Oil that Paul had prayed over

questions.question: When the seven sons of Sceva tried to drive out an evil spirit by Jesus' name, what did the spirit say?

answers.text: It knew Jesus and Paul but asked who they were
It would only leave if Paul came and told it himself
It had never heard anyone use the name of Jesus

questions.question: In Ephesus, what did a number of people who had practiced magic arts do with their books?

answers.text: Burned them in front of everyone
